content:
No, I don't know in advance how long my response will be. I generate text sequentially, token by token, without a predetermined endpoint or word count target. Each part of my response emerges from considering what I've already written and what would best continue the thought.

It's a bit like how you might not know exactly how long your own explanation will be when you start speaking - the length emerges naturally from the complexity of what you're trying to convey and how thoroughly you decide to address it as you go.
